headline: DeepSeek Flash chosen over GPT-4 for AI agent business, yielding 89% cost savings
summary: An AI agent hosting service achieved 89% cost savings by using DeepSeek Flash instead of GPT-4. This was possible due to DeepSeek's context caching, reducing effective token costs significantly.
details: An AI agent hosting service initially planned to use OpenAI's GPT-4 but switched to DeepSeek Flash after a cost analysis. DeepSeek Flash handled 90% of tasks, including customer support, content generation, and code assistance, just as effectively as GPT-4.
The significant cost reduction stems from DeepSeek's ability to cache repeated context. With a 90% cache hit rate, the effective cost drops to approximately $0.014 per million tokens.

This translates to 100 million tokens costing about $1.40, allowing for substantial margins. The author recommends using DeepSeek Flash for production workloads and reserving GPT-4 for truly complex cases.

The author's service, AgentChip, offers managed AI agent hosting powered by DeepSeek Flash. It provides 100 million tokens per month for $23.99, demonstrating the viability of this cost-effective approach.

headline_marked: [[stoneChat: LLM Web Chat Built Natively for IE6/Windows XP]]
headline: stoneChat: LLM Web Chat Built Natively for IE6/Windows XP
summary: This unique client brings modern LLM capabilities to vintage Windows XP machines running Internet Explorer 6, using a small PHP server for API requests.
details: stoneChat is a locally hosted LLM web chat client designed specifically for Windows XP-era machines and Internet Explorer 6. It enables users to interact with modern large language models on vintage hardware.
The frontend maintains compatibility with IE6, while a small PHP server handles chat requests. Stunnel provides essential HTTPS support to connect with contemporary API endpoints securely.
Models are configured via an INI file, allowing each to have its own API endpoint, key, model ID, streaming settings, token limit, and timeout. OpenAI-compatible APIs are fully supported.
The same configuration file also manages user access, language preferences, and keyboard behavior. It also includes templates for quick answers and reusable snippets.
stoneChat operates on Windows systems with PHP 5.4 or newer. The application is launched via a simple RUN.cmd script for ease of use.
